description: This source file defines configuration options and validation logic for a Simple Queue Cache in Orleans. It includes a class for cache options with a default size, and a validator class to ensure the cache size is valid.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCacheOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for the simple queue cache, primarily its size.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCacheOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the 'SimpleQueueCacheOptions' instance to ensure its 'CacheSize' is greater than zero.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks that the cache size is positive; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of the validator based on service provider and provider name.
